name: hybrid-terminal-qa
description: QA-only tools for the standalone Hybrid Terminal; no application runtime dependencies

scripts.test: npm run check:source && npm run test:app && npm run test:research && npm run test:audit && npm run test:contract && npm run test:preparation && npm run test:presentation
scripts.test:app: node scripts/run-qa.cjs app && node --test tests/product-context.cjs && node --test tests/price-card.cjs && node --test tests/plan-workspace.cjs && node --test tests/countdown.cjs && node --test tests/binary-break-even.cjs
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/run-qa.cjs browser && node --require ./scripts/mock-browser-hooks.cjs tests/browser-product-context.cjs && node --require ./scripts/mock-browser-hooks.cjs tests/browser-price-card.cjs && node --require ./scripts/mock-browser-hooks.cjs tests/browser-plan-workspace.cjs && node --require ./scripts/mock-browser-hooks.cjs tests/browser-countdown.cjs && node --require ./scripts/mock-browser-hooks.cjs tests/browser-binary-break-even.cjs
scripts.test:preparation: node --require ./research/source-context/preload.cjs --test tests/preparation.cjs && node --require ./research/source-context/pilot-0.4.17.cjs --test tests/policy-pilot.cjs && node --test tests/derivatives-pilot.cjs && node --test tests/aggression-increment.cjs && node --test tests/candidate-context.cjs
